copy_checks.evidence: Exactly six unique product objects each contain product_name, product_usp, eyebrow, headline, description, feature_copy, proof_copy and cta plus ingredient/preparation/trace/use/status/gates.
Core four, second-wave savory and conditional Fig Leaf tiers match the accepted Stage 2 commercial hypothesis and do not imply simultaneous six-SKU production.
L0–L4 architecture and recognition→peel→inspect→spoon→truth_panel sequence preserve direct print, external-only fiber and physical/legal validation gates.
No nutrition, health, origin, packaging-performance or sustainability claim is asserted; all unknown material, recipe and release facts remain directional or gated.

known_directional_limits: The customer image compresses active foil peel and visible first-spoon evidence into one truthful sequential-use frame; it is not usability-test evidence.
All food colors, ingredient distributions and package materials must be replaced or confirmed with approved physical R&D prototypes before consumer factual use.
The generated cup artwork contains only MORA and THYME HONEY; actual market-specific legal artwork remains outside this visual and requires validation.
